description: Source code for an API documentation parser that reads markdown files, extracts class/method/parameter info, and constructs a structured API representation.

classes.name: ApiParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing markdown API documentation files and extracting class, method, and parameter information.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads markdown files from directory, and builds internal API structure.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses class definitions from markdown nodes.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses class members such as methods, events, and properties.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Parses type annotations for parameters and properties.

methods.name: parseVariable
methods.description: Parses variable declarations from markdown lines.

methods.name: applyTemplates
methods.description: Applies markdown templates to generate documentation content.

methods.name: extractComments
methods.description: Extracts comment nodes from markdown documentation.

methods.name: parseApi
methods.description: Entry point to parse API documentation from directory and optional params file.
